svg.title: Grocery Sales Medallion Architecture — Bronze, Silver, Gold
svg.desc: Three-layer medallion architecture for the Grocery Sales DWH project: Bronze is raw ingestion from CSV files, Silver is cleaned and conformed data, Gold is the star-schema DWH with Fact_Sales and dimension tables.
